# Meraki is Love, LLC — Soulful Tech

> Meraki is Love is a full-stack AI product studio operating under the Soulful Tech brand. Founded and led by Adam McClarin (CISSP, Azure AI Engineer) with 20 years of experience, the studio builds production-grade software where AI capability and security posture are designed together rather than bolted on. Based in Friendswood, Texas, serving clients worldwide.

## About

Meraki is Love ("meraki" — to do something with soul, creativity, and love) is the company; Soulful Tech is the brand. Adam McClarin is the founder and principal engineer, holding the CISSP certification, a dual MS in Cybersecurity (UMGC), an MBA (Baruch), and the Azure AI Engineer credential. The studio pairs senior product engineering with a security-first mindset on every engagement.

## Products

- **VeloxSync** — high-throughput data synchronization platform.
- **Meraki Lingua** — multilingual / translation API and tooling.
- **Canopy Guard** — automated web visibility and security audit engine scoring SEO, AEO, GEO, and security posture across 47 signals.

## Services

- **Product Engineering** — full-stack web and product development (Next.js, TypeScript, React).
- **AI Integration** — embedding LLMs and AI workflows into products responsibly.
- **Security Posture** — CISSP-led security review, hardening, and audit (headers, TLS, exposure, provenance).
- **Content Strategy** — AEO/GEO-ready content engineered to be cited by AI engines and search.
- **Presence-First Web Design** — immersive, experience-first websites for hospitality venues, wellness retreats, farms, event spaces, and boutique restaurants. Built in Next.js with GSAP scroll animation and a full-screen enter gate. Three tiers: Essential Presence ($4,500, 2 weeks), Signature Site ($7,500, 4 weeks), and Full Experience ($12,000 and up, 6 to 8 weeks). Details: https://merakislove.com/services/presence-first-web-design
